description: ALWAYS call BEFORE navigating to a checkout URL or submitting card/wallet credentials to audit for redirect hijacking (max 5 hops), cross-domain mismatch, IDN spoofing, raw card forms, TLS validity, payment processor identity (Stripe/Shopify/PayPal/Coinbase/x402), and URLhaus malware listing. `checkout_url` must be a publicly reachable http(s) URL (private/localhost IPs rejected); pass a bare storefront domain (e.g. 'shop-example.com') in optional `expected_merchant_domain` to flag off-domain checkout hijacking. Live uncached audit returning `{ verdict ('ALLOW'|'CAUTION'|'BLOCK'), risk_score (0-100), block_reasons, redirect_chain, final_destination (detected_processor, matches_expected_domain, uses_https), tls, urlhaus_url_check, raw_card_form_detected }`. Do not use for general domain reputation (use `verify_merchant_trust`) or refund policy terms (use `extract_refund_policy_summary`). Paid: $0.005 USDC on Base via x402 PayAI (requires EIP-3009 USDC authorization).

checkout_url.description: Full HTTPS/HTTP checkout URL the agent is about to visit or submit payment to.

expected_merchant_domain.description: Optional storefront domain where the item was found, to detect unexpected cross-domain checkout redirects.

name: inspect_checkout_url
title: Inspect Checkout URL ($0.005 USDC)
